item.title: Dow falls 400 points, oil spike moderates amid Middle East tensions
item.description: U.S. stocks fell Tuesday as Middle East tensions drive oil prices higher, increasing investor fears of inflation and global trade disruptions.

item.title: Progressive lawmakers Bernie Sanders, Ro Khanna unveil $4.4T wealth tax targeting billionaires
item.description: Progressive lawmakers Bernie Sanders and Ro Khanna unveil a 5% annual wealth tax on billionaires' assets exceeding $1 billion to fundamentally reshape America's current tax system.

item.title: StubHub launches first-ever women's sports ticketing platform after post-Olympics surge
item.description: StubHub's new HerSportsHub platform comes after women's sports ticket demand surged 360% for WNBA and 150% for NWSL following the 2024 Paris Olympics.

item.title: Stanley Black & Decker to cut hundreds of jobs, shut Connecticut plant
item.description: Stanley Black & Decker will eliminate about 300 jobs and close a Connecticut tape-measure plant as demand declines, part of its multiyear restructuring plan.

item.title: Papa John's to close hundreds of restaurants
item.description: Papa John's plans to close 300 underperforming restaurants in North America by 2027, with 200 closures expected this year, CFO Ravi Thanawala said.

item.title: Blockchain analysts say traders may have used insider information to profit on Iran conflict bets
item.description: Suspected insider traders allegedly made $1.2 million betting on Iran strikes hours before they happened, sparking calls to ban war-related prediction markets.

item.title: Trump threatens to cut off trade with Spain over Iran, defense spending
item.description: President Donald Trump said he may halt trade with Spain, calling the NATO ally “unfriendly" over defense spending and base access for anti-Iran operations.

item.title: X creators must disclose AI-generated armed conflict videos or face consequences
item.description: X announced new penalties for creators posting undisclosed AI-generated videos of armed conflicts, including 90-day revenue-sharing suspensions for violations.

item.title: Travelers stranded in Dubai paying huge sums to flee on private charter flights amid Operation Epic Fury
item.description: Wealthy travelers reportedly pay hefty sums for private jets to flee the Middle East after airport closures from Operation Epic Fury force evacuations.

item.title: Over 650,000 bottles of water recalled after being packaged in 'insanitary conditions'
item.description: More than 650,000 bottles of water are being recalled, according to an enforcement report issued by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
